title: Pending task
description: Work queued for later because it needs something that isn't available now: a person online with a browser, or the next research run. Created by triggers (onboarding, festival, schedule, intake), shown by tracker status, picked up by research-methods. Logical record: the Tasks tab (Sheets) or tasks.json (files).

task_id.description: T-<yyyymmdd>-<n>: creation date plus a counter for that day (1 + the highest n already used that day).

kind.description: research-run = a research run to do (unattended part first); research-browser-step = the attended Instagram read for an existing insight sheet.

job_id.description: The job that triggered it, if any.

insight_id.description: For browser steps: the sheet to complete.

occasion.description: Festival runs: the occasion from the client's festival calendar.

estimate_minutes.description: Shown in status, e.g. 'needs browser, ~10 min'.

due.description: Do it by this date (festival runs: 14 days before the occasion).

created_by.description: Team handle, or 'system' for scheduled and automatic triggers.
